Dear Customer Support Team,

I have attached copies of the relevant invoices and confirmation emails for your reference. If you require any additional information or access to my account, please let me know, and I will provide it promptly.

Thank you for your prompt attention to this matter. I appreciate your assistance in ensuring that my travel expenses are accurately reflected and that I can submit my reimbursement requests without further delay.

Best regards,
